entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I think I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

Oh, no, it works fine. It's... it's just not for me. I feel awful about it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for this, but things are a little tight right now and I really needed this money back for some unexpected bills.

I completely understand that sometimes a product just isn't the right fit, and that circumstances can change. I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up your account?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered to you on December 20th, which was 24 days ago. Let me just review our return eligibility.
Oh, I was so worried it would be too late. I hope the policy allows for it.
Alright, I've just checked the policy, and you have nothing to worry about. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this returned for a full refund.
Really? Oh, that is the best news I've heard all week! Thank you, Alex, that's such a relief. I was so stressed about it.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now, and it should be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. And since I see here you're a VIP member with us, as a thank you for your understanding and continued loyalty, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Wow, you didn't have to do that! That's so kind. You've really turned my day around. VeloFit always has the best service.
We appreciate you, and we're sorry this particular product wasn't the right one this time. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex!
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day!
